Both rails were traced at 7x and are unbroken inside the frame. Net map: 0 = the entire LEFT rail. (2) V-DC 2, bbox centre (267.7,-158.9), 71.9x70.3 -> a round source symbol sitting between the two rails (x 232..304 lies between the left rail's extrapolated x~108 and the right rail's x~373), i.e. it is the top rung, 159 px above the frame. This is the only reading that leaves nothing dangling; every alternative arrangement below the frame (C3 in series on the left rail then across, or C3 in series under L4 then across) yields the SAME two nets, so the net map is robust even though the exact geometry below the edge is unseen.
